verdict.rationale: Airwallex's official CLI is documented as a scriptable terminal tool for automation: it can 'script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems', installs with a one-line curl script, and defaults to sandbox with a `--prod` opt-in. Scoped API keys and a separate sandbox support unattended, least-privilege runs against a test environment. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), a documented non-interactive CLI auth path (CLI auth is described as OAuth role-gated to Owner/Admin/Finance Admin), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
